$comment: Per-golden zero-regression baseline (YOY-116 AC-5): recorded from the accuracy-only harness run on main before lite-first routing landed (2026-08-26, hit rate 97%, 30/31 goldens, 9/9 refinements clean). `goldens` maps golden id -> whether an expected product ranked in the top 10; `refinements` maps refinement golden id -> whether the merged intent had zero constraint misses. harness.test.ts asserts every true here is still true. Regenerate only when a golden legitimately changes, never to absorb a regression. g24 (YOY-110, 2026-08-27) was added with the primary-colour fixture products and baselined from its first live-recorded run. g25 (YOY-111, 2026-08-27) is a zero-hit golden scored on the close-match ladder; true means the ladder contract held. g26 (classic route) and g27 (AI route) (YOY-117, 2026-08-27) score the colourway-family collapse; baselined from its first live-recorded run. `routes` (YOY-133 AC-4, 2026-08-28) maps every golden of the main, Constructor-bar, and sparse sets to the route it takes; harness.test.ts asserts each run's route equals it, so a routing change is visible in the scorecard diff — co09 moved classic → ai with the purpose-phrase heuristic, every other route byte-identical.
